To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose Dynamic Variable Effortion (DyVE) Deep Neural Networks (DeepNNs) which exploit the heterogeniety in the characteristics of the inputs to DeepNNs to improve compute efficiency while maintaining accuracy.
DyVEDeep is an efficient dynamic DNN inference framework, which exploits heterogeneity in the input data to improve the compute efficiency of DNNs.

DyVEDeep, our dynamic variable effort deep neural network, reduces the compute effort required to process an input by 1.9x-2.3x, while achieving similar accuracy to the original DNN, for a variety of image classification tasks.
